text.tspan: WS2 - PART 2 - Pooled Multi-Tenant Agent Platform Architecture (Pattern A: Pool)
Google Cloud — Centralized Multi-Tenant Governance & Control Plane
Inline Model Armor & Cloud DLP inspection
Shared 32k prefix cache & Valkey token budgets
Pooled Memory Bank & Data (AlloyDB FORCE RLS)
AI Observability — Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace, OpenTelemetry & Per-Tenant Token Metering
Zero-PII SHA-256 prompt hashing • BigQuery FinOps chargeback • Deterministic 401/403/429/422 circuit-breaker alerts
WHO RUNS WHAT IN PATTERN A (POOL • 1.0x BASELINE COGS)
Identity, ingress, 2 gateways, registry, rate limits & audit
ISV-operated: one shared stack for every tenant. Both gateways, ARD PDP, and Valkey rate
limiter sit on the shared path.
Front end, pooled ADK runtime (Cloud Run / GKE WarmPool), MCP & models
Mode A wipes worker RAM after 1 turn (CoW); Mode B latches GKE WarmPool pods (403); models
Sessions (Valkey) + Memory Bank & Data (AlloyDB FORCE RLS)
Two shared stores: Valkey {tenant}:{user} keys (<5s UNLINK) and AlloyDB kernel FORCE ROW
Tenant users and IdPs (left) are not a plane. Enterprise APIs (right) lead to systems outside the
platform; the ISV does not run them.
